title: A broad dollar day and gold over the next five days

rule.breadth: all six of EURUSD, GBPUSD, AUDUSD (down) and USDJPY, USDCAD, USDCHF (up) move the dollar's way on the day (mirror for a down day)
rule.dxy: council/macro.mjs dxySeries on folded daily closes; its return beyond 1 x the sd of the 20 returns before the day
rule.costs: $0.60 a trade + nights() x FIN.xau.long on buys
rule.baseline: same-side trade entered on every eligible day, mean net R per calendar year of the entry; excess = trade net minus it

tests.what: broad dollar-up day: buy gold, hold 5 days (primary)
broad dollar-down day: sell gold, hold 5 days
broad dollar-up day on which gold also fell > 0.5 sd: buy gold, hold 5 days
